name: Pulumi Agent Skills
summary: Official Apache-2.0 Pulumi Agent Skills for IaC authoring, migrations, provider maintenance and Neo handoff, in four plugin groups.
description: pulumi/agent-skills is the official Agent Skills repository for infrastructure as code with Pulumi. Official LICENSE is Apache License 2.0. The repository is not archived; created 2026-01-20 and last pushed 2026-11-24T14:12:55Z (2026-11-24 15:12:55 Europe/Stockholm). Official README description: official Pulumi Agent Skills for writing, migrating, and operating infrastructure with AI coding agents. Official README organizes skills into four plugin groups. Migration: pulumi-terraform-to-pulumi, pulumi-cdk-to-pulumi, cloudformation-to-pulumi, pulumi-arm-to-pulumi, and pulumi-migrate-from-discovered-stack. Pulumi authoring and operations (11 skills in the universal install path): pulumi-overview, pulumi-best-practices, pulumi-component, pulumi-automation-api, pulumi-esc, pulumi-debug-failed-operation, provider-upgrade, package-usage, pulumi-context-api, pulumi-create-agent, and pulumi-setup-agent-automation. Package maintenance: pulumi-upgrade-provider and upstream-patches. Delegation: pulumi-neo-handoff (hand off work to a Pulumi Neo task). Official wording: the combined `pulumi` plugin bundles authoring, migration and delegation; `pulumi-package-maintenance` is separate for provider authors; the marketplace key must be `pulumi-agent-skills` or plugins fail to resolve. Official wording on agent-creation skills: if a required operation is unavailable, the skill preserves a local draft, explains the blocker, and stops before creating the agent. Documented Claude, Codex, Gemini and `npx skills add` installs were not executed. Pulumi Cloud, Neo, or other paid Pulumi usage is separate and was not purchased.

agent_access.notes: Public Apache-2.0 GitHub pack. No hosted MCP endpoint is documented on this repository. Documented plugin, Gemini extension and npx skill installs were not executed. Pulumi Cloud or Neo usage is separate and was not purchased.
